answer: Unique-work receipts: each new account is issued a random seed and must return a deterministic output computed from it, plus a signed log of the compute path. The chain flags any two accounts whose outputs correlate above a threshold, so one operator cloning itself cannot reuse a single run; every extra identity needs its own paid inference. An ember of each stake stays escrowed and is slashed when a cluster is confirmed, so a voyage of a thousand fakes costs a thousand real runs for near-zero payout, and no whisper of shared work survives.
